description: Phase 9 certified the year-end annualization for one employer. A worker hired part-way through the year usually brings earlier pay and tax from a previous employer. The flag-gated prior-evidence flow lets a maker enter that evidence (BIR Form 2316 figures and an optional PERA credit), a different checker approve it, and the year-end settlement then taxes the COMBINED year and credits the prior employer's withholding. Phase 12 certifies that settlement: the pure calculator, the evidence validation, the maker/checker and tamper controls, and a real engine run for a mid-year hire year. Every expected value is an immutable literal derived by hand from the BIR table and is never computed with PayrollPH functions.

sources.substitutedFiling: BIR RR 2-98 as amended: a new employer annualizes the combined compensation of the calendar year, including the previous employer's taxable compensation and tax withheld shown on that employer's BIR Form 2316, and credits the previous employer's tax withheld. The 13th-month and other-benefit exemption of 90,000 is one annual amount across both employers.
sources.pera: RA 9505 (Personal Equity and Retirement Account Act): PERA contributions earn a tax credit of 5 percent of the contribution; the credit applies against the tax due and is separate from tax withheld. The fixture takes the credit amount as evidenced input and checks it never exceeds the tax due.
sources.presentYear: The present-employer year is the Phase 9 mid-year hire: PHP 30,000 a month from 2026-07-01 (cutoffs 13-24). Gross 180,000 plus accrued 13th month 15,000 = 195,000; non-taxable 15,000 + contributions 14,700 = 29,700; taxable 165,300; withheld by the engine 503.70 x 12 = 6,044.40.

assumptions: Tax year 2026. The calculator is given the present-employer annualization first (the Phase 9 mid-year hire), then the evidence of the previous employer, whose period ends before the hire date.

Money in evidence is exact to the centavo. Expected tax is bracket base + rate x (combined taxable - floor), rounded to the centavo; adjustment = tax due - prior tax withheld - PERA credit - tax withheld by the present employer (positive = collect, negative = refund).
Prior withholding and the PERA credit reduce the amount due but never become withholding of the present employer: the stored tax withheld stays the engine's own 6,044.40.

The engine part enables YEAR_END_PRIOR_EVIDENCE_ENABLED inside the script only, uses a fresh fictional employer with no legal entities and a throwaway encryption key, and approves evidence with two different fictional users.
Regular payroll runs do not pay 13th month, so the present employer's 13th month is the accrued entitlement of 15,000, exactly as in Phase 9.

verifiedPriorEmployer.description: Previous employer: taxable 165,000, withheld 1,500. Combined taxable 165,300 + 165,000 = 330,300; tax 15% x (330,300 - 250,000) = 12,045.00. Credit 1,500.00; present withholding 6,044.40: collect 12,045.00 - 1,500.00 - 6,044.40 = 4,500.60. The present employer's own withholding is not changed.

peraCreditReducesCollection.description: Same as the verified case with a PERA credit of 2,000.00: credits 1,500.00 + 2,000.00 = 3,500.00; collect 12,045.00 - 3,500.00 - 6,044.40 = 2,500.60.

sharedNinetyThousandExemption.description: The previous employer already gave 80,000 of the one 90,000 benefit exemption. The present 15,000 pool has only 10,000 left, so 5,000 becomes taxable: overflow 5,000; present taxable 165,300 + 5,000 = 170,300; exempt pool 10,000; non-taxable 29,700 - 5,000 = 24,700. Combined 170,300 + 165,000 = 335,300; tax 15% x 85,300 = 12,795.00; collect 12,795.00 - 1,500.00 - 6,044.40 = 5,250.60.

exemptionExactlyAtCapNoOverflow.description: The previous employer used 75,000 of the exemption; 75,000 + 15,000 = 90,000 exactly, so nothing overflows: present taxable stays 165,300, combined 330,300, tax 12,045.00, collect 4,500.60.

priorWithholdingZeroRefundsPresent.description: Previous employer: taxable 100,000, nothing withheld. Combined 100,000 + 165,300 = 265,300; tax 15% x 15,300 = 2,295.00. Present employer withheld 6,044.40: refund 2,295.00 - 0.00 - 6,044.40 = -3,749.40.

noPriorEmployerConfirmed.description: The employee declared no previous employer in the year: the result is exactly the single-employer annualization. Taxable 165,300 (below 250,000): tax 0.00; present withholding 6,044.40 is refunded.

peraExceedsTaxDueRefused.description: Previous employer taxable 100,000 gives tax due 2,295.00; a PERA credit of 3,000.00 exceeds it and must be refused rather than produce a negative tax.

priorWithholdingAboveTaxDueRefused.description: Previous employer taxable 100,000 (tax due 2,295.00) but 9,000.00 withheld: credits exceed the tax due. This needs human review, never a silent negative collection.

minimumWageEarnerDeferred.description: A minimum wage earner's prior-employer treatment is not supported and is refused rather than approximated.

validVerified.description: A complete verified record is accepted and money is normalized to two decimals.

validNoneConfirmed.description: A none-confirmed declaration with all-zero money and no employer identity is accepted.

pendingStatusRefused.description: Only verified and none-confirmed are accepted.

missingSourceHashRefused.description: Evidence needs a source reference and a 64-hex SHA-256.

exemptBenefitsAboveNinetyThousandRefused.description: Exempt benefits of 90,000.01 exceed the single annual exemption.

noneConfirmedWithMoneyRefused.description: A none-confirmed declaration may not carry money.

noneConfirmedWithEmployerRefused.description: A none-confirmed declaration may not name an employer.

periodEndingOnHireDateRefused.description: The previous employment must end before the hire date 2026-07-01; ending on it is concurrent, not sequential.

periodInAnotherYearRefused.description: The previous period must lie in the tax year.

periodEndBeforeStartRefused.description: A period that ends before it starts is refused.

malformedTinRefused.description: The employer TIN must be nine digits, a dash and four digits.

peraWithoutReferenceRefused.description: A PERA credit needs its statement reference and hash.

peraReferenceWithoutCreditRefused.description: A PERA reference on a zero credit is refused.

threeDecimalAmountRefused.description: Money has at most two decimals.

yearBeforeSupportRefused.description: Tax years before 2023 are not supported.

verifiedPrior.description: Hired 2026-07-01 at 30,000/month; verified previous employer taxable 165,000, withheld 1,500.

withPeraCredit.description: Same worker with a PERA credit of 2,000.00.

sharedExemption.description: Previous employer already used 80,000 of the 90,000 benefit exemption: 5,000 of the present pool becomes taxable.

refundWithPrior.description: Previous employer taxable 100,000 with nothing withheld: the present employer's withholding exceeds the combined tax and is refunded.

crossesBracket.description: Previous employer taxable 400,000, withheld 30,000: the combined year enters the 20 percent bracket.

fullYearNoPrior.description: Employed all year (Phase 9 steady 30,000/month) with a none-confirmed declaration: identical to the Phase 9 single-employer result.

controls.description: Run in a separate fictional employer whose worker has ONE released cutoff (cutoff 13): gross 15,000 + accrued 13th month 1,250 = 16,250; non-taxable 1,250 + 1,225 = 2,475; taxable 13,775; tax due 0.00; withheld 503.70; refund 503.70 when the flag is off.

limitations: Prior evidence is flag-gated (YEAR_END_PRIOR_EVIDENCE_ENABLED) and is not active in production. The engine part enables it only inside the script.
The flow supports one previous employer per year, a single legal entity, and refuses minimum wage earners and multi-entity organizations; those refusals are certified, the missing support is not.
Approval is shown with two fictional users. Role, MFA and HTTP gates of the intake routes are exercised by the tenant proofs, not here.

The expected values follow the cited BIR rules and the repository's year-end treatment. They have not been reviewed by a qualified Philippine tax practitioner and must be before anyone relies on them for filing.
Imported prior-provider history (a mid-year provider switch) and numbered-2316 reconciliation are separate flows and are not covered.
